chaosStar.description: You are suffused with Sigmar’s holy wrath. In the absence of enemies, while this blessing recharges, you will turn on allies, beginning with the least pious.

sigmarsComet.description: You are instantly healed of all wounds and all non-Severe Injury critical wounds.

conservative.requirements: 12 favour. You must brandish a holy relic when you invoke this blessing. Special: Whether or not you successfully invoke this blessing, the holy relic is consumed. Effect: You become imbued with Sigmar’s presence, becoming his avatar. You nearly double in size and shine with golden radiance. While this blessing is recharging, you gain +1 to all characteristics, +2 to your Wound Threshold, and your DR, CR, Defence, and Soak values all improve by 1.
